content.short: NFT that resembles the owner, not someone else.
content.description:
Alphatron is a set of physical mini alphabet figures that can transform and combine. Through the digital art of NFT, Alphatron opt to provide collections of collectable assets that can truly fulfils the criteria of “”BEING YOURS. “

A series of “Givennames” & “initials” available for minting, together with the free giveaway of the alphabet figures.

The ownership of an NFT is no longer in the virtual world only! it also became an asset that you can feel, touch & play. Enjoying the full spectrum of virtual & physical ownership.
